descriptors.name: claim_step

descriptors.description: Claim one step from the exact owner-confirmed Plan version as the agent.

descriptors.name: get_goal_room_state
descriptors.title: Get governed Goal Room state
descriptors.description: Read a compact recovery-oriented projection of the current authority frontier without changing the room.

descriptors.name: propose_goal_contract
descriptors.title: Propose an immutable Goal Contract
descriptors.description: Propose Goal Contract data as the agent after owner intent or an owner revision request. Nonblank checks trim whitespace, while maxLength counts raw Unicode code points exactly like JSON Schema; accepted values are then stored trimmed. This never confirms the Goal or authorizes Plan work; the owner must confirm or request revision.

descriptors.name: propose_plan
descriptors.title: Propose an immutable Goal Plan
descriptors.description: Propose a versioned Plan as the agent. In GOAL_CONTRACT_CONFIRMED, pass the exact goalContractVersion exposed by get_goal_room_state; legacy DRAFT and PLAN_REVISION_REQUESTED calls may omit it. This never confirms the Plan; the owner must confirm or request revision.

descriptors.name: request_completion
descriptors.title: Request final owner acceptance
descriptors.description: Request completion for the exact active candidate after deterministic PASS. This does not accept the Goal.

descriptors.name: submit_artifact
descriptors.title: Submit exact candidate evidence
descriptors.description: Submit immutable candidate bytes and their declared SHA-256 for the currently claimed Plan step. WorkHub recomputes the digest.
